The '''Hidden Daggers Eliminator''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Hidden Daggers]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Rhea]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] tasked a pilot with [[Death/Legends|killing]] the Hidden Daggers Eliminator.<ref name="SWG:DtHDE" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateHiddendaggerPilots.jpg|thumb|right|250px|All possible depictions of the Hidden Daggers Eliminator]]
The Hidden Daggers Eliminator appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DtHDE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Hidden Daggers Eliminator was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:DtHDE" />
